name: NeoEvalPlusN_benchmark
description: Since automatic open source benchmark leaderboard got flooded with incoherent overtrained cheater meme models, I decided to take the matters in my own hands and create my own set of proprietary tests. The aim of these tests is not to see how smart the model is, but to see how good it is at execution of commands and creative writing in a reasonably quantifiable way. reputation: Personal/proprietary benchmark created by its author; limited public adoption and primarily used by the creator for ad-hoc evaluation.
